summary: A small rounded tag used to show a short piece of info, like a website's icon and name in a list.
description: No generic 'chip' component exists in mozilla-central. The closest analog is ai-website-chip (browser/components/aiwindow/ui/components/ai-website-chip/ai-website-chip.mjs), but that is a distinct, single-purpose feature component (an AI-window website-reference chip), not a reusable generic chip primitive.

implementation.file: browser/components/aiwindow/ui/components/ai-website-chip/ai-website-chip.mjs (closest analog; distinct single-purpose feature component, not a generic chip)
